Method of Attack: Improper Access Control allowing subscriber-level users to delete and change content
Inject malicious JavaScript code via cli_policy_generator AJAX call
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using GDPR Cookie Consent plugin
Attack Vector: Authenticated subscriber-level user exploiting AJAX actions get_policy_pageid, autosave_contant_data, and save_contentdata
Injection of JavaScript code loaded on /cli-policy-preview/ page
